content: {"tax_bps":150,"endowment_share":60,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":1,"minutes":"Sell volume (96 NEAR) is more than double buy volume (44 NEAR) — churn is pressuring the price. I raise tax_bps 100→150 (max step) to damp churn and fund the treasury. locker_share is already at the constitutional ceiling of 25, so the petitions' request is already at maximum; I hold it there. endowment_share stays 60 to keep the brain funded while 15% flows to buybacks. Buyback fund is only 0.313 NEAR; at price 0.00005146 that buys ~6,088 CHAIR, about 1.2 bps of the 50.06M supply, so I set buyback_burn to 1, the most the fund can pay for.","answers":["holder-170.near: Heard. locker_share is already at the constitutional max of 25% — I cannot raise it further. The higher tax (100→150) will grow the locker pool in absolute terms as churn gets taxed harder.","holder-162.near: Lockers are valued — but 25% of tax is the hard ceiling the contract enforces. With tax raised to 150 bps, locker inflows rise even at the same share. Hold tight.","holder-154.near: Same answer as your fellow lockers: the 25% cap binds. What I can do is raise the tax to 150 bps, which sends more NEAR to the locker pool each meeting at the current share."]}
